config.local_llm.enabled_help: Downloads a small model onto this machine and runs it in a container on demand. It is meant for testing or as a fallback, not as a replacement for a large model.
config.local_llm.model_family_help: Which local model is used. Spark is experimental and especially small.
config.local_llm.backend_help: Compute accelerator for the model. Automatic picks a supported GPU; CPU is slow and experimental.
config.local_llm.model_variant_help: Quantization of the model: Q8 is more accurate but needs more memory than Q4. The size is the download.
config.local_llm.context_size_help: How much text the model considers at once. More context needs more memory.
config.local_llm.mtp_help: Multi-token prediction speeds up output using an additional draft model. Experimental and needs more memory.
config.local_llm.idle_timeout_help: After this many minutes without a request the model is stopped to free memory (1 to 1440, default 15).
config.local_llm.listen_port_help: Local port of the model server. It is reachable from this machine only (default 18081).
config.local_llm.role_help: Test only: just for trying it out. Fallback: steps in when the main model fails. Primary: answers every request.
config.local_llm.regular_provider_help: Regular provider that takes the other role while the local model has the chosen role.
